body: context-cache.ts staleness; path schema allows #Sheet2, #slide-12, #p4 anchors; wt: hash vs blob id.

completion.releaseNote: Cards work for Office files: pass the version you see to `card get --seen`, and save a card for one sheet, slide or page with `file#part`.
completion.summary: Commit f6f8de9. `card get --seen` and `context_get` `seen` compare the caller's file version with the card's sourceSeen (adds staleness, never hides a change the file list shows; refused without a path). Card paths may end in an anchor (`budget.xlsx#Sheet2`); staleness hashes the file part. In git mode a dirty file is hashed as its git blob id, so a card saved before the commit stays fresh after it. Verified: core 350 tests, MCP 30, CLI pass (two git-hook tests time out at 5 s only under machine load), typecheck, build, manual CLI walkthrough. Not covered: repos that rewrite content on add (autocrlf, LFS).

title: 9c Cards: compare sourceSeen, anchors (file#part), no false stale after commit
